author: Inside Edition
description: Gas station customers danced to get 20% off prices at the pump. Dancing for gas is happening at the Sunoco Station and Halfmoon Car Wash outside Albany, New York. A sign on a cash register reads "want a discount? Show us your best dance move." Accompanied by the Whitney Houston classic "I Wanna Dance With Somebody," customers are getting down for discounts.
title: These Customers Dance To Get Discounted Gas

author: Inside Edition
description: Is Luigi Mangione, who is accused of assassinating United Healthcare CEO Brian Thompson in 2024, about to plead guilty to federal charges? Prosecutors and his defense team jointly asked for an emergency hearing in federal court Friday. There is growing speculation that some kind of deal has been hammered out. Mangione has several supporters who say they have had bad experiences with the healthcare system.
title: Is Luigi Mangione Going To Make A Plea Deal?

author: Inside Edition
description: Police pulled over a car and told the driver that he had just been banned from all Walmart stores for life. The driver's name is Damon Darling, a comedian who became a social media sensation for paying for groceries at Walmart stores in Ohio. Despite his good deeds, the nation's largest retailer is fed up, saying he "repeatedly violated their policies through disruptive behavior and trespassing, unrelated to any charitable giving." Inside Edition spoke with the comedian as he prepares for a nationwide tour.
title: Comedian Viral For Buying Stranger's Groceries Banned From Walmart For Life
